scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.japan:catalogue:generate: pnpm run japan:reviews:validate && pnpm --filter @workspace/japan-ski-catalogue run generate
scripts.japan:catalogue:generate:check: pnpm run japan:reviews:validate && pnpm --filter @workspace/japan-ski-catalogue run generate:check
scripts.japan:catalogue:validate: pnpm run japan:reviews:validate && pnpm --filter @workspace/japan-ski-catalogue run validate
scripts.japan:catalogue:report: pnpm run japan:reviews:validate && pnpm --filter @workspace/japan-ski-catalogue run report
